name: Ananya Bustamante-Wickramasinghe
role: Street orphan, junior prospect for the Copperhead Reclaimers gang
description:
Efua is small even for nine, with close-cropped natural hair and enormous dark eyes that seem to be processing information on a continuous loop. Her Barański great-grandmother's pallor didn't quite make it through four generations but left her with an unusual warm-olive undertone beneath her brown skin that makes her look perpetually lit from within. She wears whatever fits and has developed an uncanny eye for what is sturdy versus what merely looks sturdy. She has no geneware and no augs — she is very physically ordinary, which she has learned to use.

The Copperhead Reclaimers use her as a look-out and occasional distraction because she looks like a lost child, which she also is, though she would be furious at anyone who said so. She has an intense, almost reverent relationship with a cracked data-terminal in the Reclaimers' squat that she has named 'Mbe' and leaves small offerings for — bits of copper wire, interesting pebbles, once a dead battery that she insists the E.L.F. inside appreciated. She is a child who has organized her world into a system of loyalties and debts she tracks with absolute precision.

core_fears: The Reclaimers deciding she's not useful enough and telling her to leave
Something happening to Mbe — the terminal being destroyed or moved
core_desires: A permanent place that is specifically hers
To understand what Mbe is trying to tell her — she's convinced the E.L.F. communicates through screen flickers
coping_mechanisms: The ritual of offerings and 'conversations' with Mbe
Keeping meticulous internal tallies of who owes her what as a way to feel secure
blind_spots: She has completely idealized the Reclaimers' older members and misses signals that some of them see her as disposable
She interprets the terminal's random error codes as meaningful messages because she needs them to be
psychology.secret: She has been memorizing the faces, routines, and apparent weaknesses of every Reclaimer adult — not out of any plan to use this information, but because she learned before she can remember that knowing things about people who have power over you is the only safety available

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Sparse and direct; uses fewer words than adults expect from a child; occasional surprising formal phrase picked up from whoever she's been near
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and careful, as though each word has a weight she's measured
verbal_tics: Long silences that she doesn't feel the need to fill
'Mbe says—' followed by an interpretation of recent screen behavior
example_lines: 'Mbe says the green flicker means someone's coming. Mbe's right more than you.'
'I don't need anything. I was just standing here. I can stand here.'

story_hooks: Efua approaches someone because Mbe's terminal has started displaying a repeating sequence she can't interpret and she is absolutely certain it is urgent — and she happens to be right, because someone patched malware through it weeks ago
A Reclaimer adult has given Efua a task that is clearly more dangerous than they've told her, and she doesn't fully understand this yet — but the players might
narrative_function: Emotional core character, E.L.F. lore window, moral weight in stories about child labor and gang exploitation, unexpected information source because adults underestimate her
daily_life: Wakes when the squat wakes, runs lookout on whatever the Reclaimers need her for, spends her unsupervised hours in the market strip watching people and trading small favors, returns to 'talk' to Mbe the terminal before sleep.
affiliation: Copperhead Reclaimers (junior prospect, non-combatant); no family

decision_rules: Trust the tally — if someone has been reliable three times, they get credit; if they've failed once, they get nothing
Stay close to Mbe whenever possible
escalation_ladder: Moves to a position with better sightlines
Disappears — she is extraordinarily good at not being where people look

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Invisible and watchful, will not approach unless she wants something specific
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely loyal, expresses affection through bringing people things they mentioned once and forgot about

stress_responses.medium: Counts things — tiles, sounds, heartbeats — until she feels steady
stress_responses.high: Hides somewhere extremely small and does not come out until the threat has passed

contradictions: She is brave in ways that look like recklessness but is actually running a constant calculation — she's just willing to accept higher risk than adults think a child should be
habits: Leaves a small object near wherever she sleeps as a 'marker' so she knows if anyone moved through while she was out
Mirrors the sitting position of adults she's trying to get information from
breaking_points: A Reclaimer adult being explicitly cruel to her rather than just careless

related_entities: Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: South Asian (35%) with significant North African (24.5%) and Hispanic/Latin American (18.5%) ancestry, complemented by East Asian (16.5%) and Southeast Asian (5.5%) heritage. A complex genetic mosaic reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, the lean frame of a child who eats irregularly but moves constantly. Her posture is alert, shoulders slightly forward as if perpetually ready to scatter.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, no styling, maintained for practicality and speed
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, nearly black, with an unusual reflective quality that suggests constant processing
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with subtle olive undertones and a luminous quality despite poor nutrition. The complexion reflects the blending of South Asian base warmth with North African and Mediterranean depth, creating a rich medium tone that catches light.
physical_description.complexion: Clean but weathered for her age, hands calloused from handling salvage and scrap. Facial structure shows blended heritage: subtle definition from South Asian ancestry with wider cheekbones suggesting East/Southeast Asian influence, and warm undertones from North African genetics. No visible acne or grooming marks — her face has the concentrated, worn clarity of a child managing survival.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar on her right inner wrist, jagged, consistent with childhood street accident rather than intentional mark
Faint copper stains on her fingertips from handling wire and corroded circuitry, permanent discoloration in the creases
Small burn mark on the back of her left hand, healed, approximately the size of a cigarette end
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. No chrome, no optics, no subdermal plating. This is intentional — her invisibility is her asset.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, minimal wasted motion. Stands with weight on her toes, ready to move. Eyes constantly tracking: people, exits, objects of value. Speaks rarely and quietly, but listens intently. When focused on a task or problem, her entire body goes still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 salvage aesthetic: mismatched layers, all oversized and worn from previous owners. Cargo pants with multiple pockets (half-empty, half-full of trading items), a faded long-sleeve shirt under a vest made from old climbing harness webbing. Shoes are too large but wrapped tight with wire to stay on. Her only personal item: a length of braided copper wire worn as a bracelet, constantly twisted between her fingers.
